### Bible Pathway - Feb. 10, 2012
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-feb-10-2012.html
Passage: Leviticus 24:4
Points:
- Aaron was given the responsibility to keep the lampstand burning continually before the Lord.
- The sacred fire lighting the lamps originated from God, not from human effort.
- Spiritual understanding cannot come from natural wisdom; it requires the Holy Spirit to illuminate Scripture.
- Like the golden lampstand that held the oil, believers should direct all attention to Christ rather than themselves.
